vulnerabilities.title: Unsanitized SQL Input in User Query Endpoint
vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
vulnerabilities.description: The 'id' query parameter in /api/v1/users is concatenated directly into SQL queries without escaping or parameterized bindings, allowing arbitrary SQL command execution and data exfiltration.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Apply patch v1.4.2 to implement parameterized queries on the user repository.
